title: Artifact Tree Virtualised Streaming
description: Artifact trees (and every other paged panel tree) must present the complete document with no +N continuation rows: children are loaded lazily when a node is expanded and only as many rows as fit the viewport are materialised, with further rows streamed in from the guest as the user scrolls. One general framework-owned mechanism (contract, SDK, React host, wgpu target) applied to every app.
